subject: Aligning demo time to VP sponsor late-join & coverage plan
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@brightworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Demo time proposal + VP sponsor request

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for agreeing to a technical walkthrough next week. Quick context: Ethan (your VP sponsor) asked to join if possible — he’s flexible but has a tight window on the 30th between 10:30–11:00am ET and then again 3:00–3:30pm ET. Our SE (Karthik) will be traveling that day and has a flight at 2:15pm, so I want to align expectations now so we don’t get blocked.

Proposed slots (all 60m):
- Mon 30 Nov — 10:00–11:00am ET (Ethan could join first 30m)
- Mon 30 Nov — 3:00–4:00pm ET (fits Ethan’s second window, partial overlap with Karthik)
- Tue 1 Dec — 11:00–12:00pm ET (no exec constraints)

If Ethan absolutely needs to attend the full session, we can either:
- Move the walkthrough to Tue 1 Dec, or
- Run the 30m executive briefing at 3:00pm followed by a hands-on handoff with an engineer recorded for later inspection.

I’ve attached the draft agenda and a mutual action plan so we can decide quickly. Can you confirm Ethan’s preference and procurement timing so we can lock a time and book backup coverage?

Thanks —
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: RDW-demo-agenda-v3.pdf (agenda, 2 pages); BWX-mutual-action-plan-202611.xlsx (MAP, editable)
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@brightworks.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo time proposal + VP sponsor request

Jasmine —

Thanks for the options. Ethan can realistically only make the 3:00–3:30pm ET slot on Mon 30 Nov. He’s asked to sit in for the executive portion and stay for Q&A if schedule permits, but procurement is pushing to finalize terms by the end of next week (we need the MAP and pricing to be stable).

If Karthik has a travel conflict at 2:15pm, would you be able to run the technical portion with another engineer or record the hands-on parts? We are ok with a two-part approach: exec briefing followed by the detailed demo recording + live QA with your CS/SE.

Procurement is CC’d for timing — they’ll need the final MAP and draft SOW to proceed.

Best,
Lena
Lena Ortiz
Head of Product Ops, Brightworks
lena.ortiz@brightworks.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Coverage plan for 30 Nov (Ethan late-join)

Team —

Looping you in to confirm how we handle Karthik’s travel conflict and ensure Ethan gets the exec window he wants. Plan proposal:

1) 3:00–3:30pm ET — Jasmine runs 30m exec briefing (value props, fit, high-level architecture). Ethan attends.
2) 3:30–3:45pm ET — Live Q&A with available engineer (Karthik might be gone). Karthik to join dial-in while en route if possible. If not, Marissa or I will sit in and run targeted technical responses; we’ll flag any deep asks to schedule a follow-up deep-dive.
3) 3:45–4:00pm ET — Start recording of hands-on session and handoff to CS for recorded walkthrough + async follow-up.

Action items:
- Jasmine: Confirm final calendar invite and add backup engineer (Marissa).
- Karthik: Share a 3–4 slide technical appendix that Marissa can use to field questions if you drop.
- Marissa: Standby as technical backup; review Karthik’s appendix before the call.

This keeps the exec window intact while preventing a hard stop if Karthik’s flight runs. Low-risk and predictable for the customer. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

- 3:30–3:45pm ET: Live Q&A (Marissa + Ben; Karthik dialing in if possible)
